query: [user] Start Kraft Lite on 'Add CSV export'. Use the quick-task chain, and here's the spec I already wrote: docs/specs/csv-export.md.
setup: A Claude Code session at the root of the repo acme/ledger (GitHub, gh installed), `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` set, the kraft-lite skills installed. There is no .kraft-lite/ directory: no bindings.yaml and no registry.yaml. `chains` prints []. `chains --available` prints: [{"id": "default", "source": "bundled", "path": "/plugins/kraft-lite/config/chains/default.yaml"}, {"id": "quick-task", "source": "bundled", "path": "/plugins/kraft-lite/config/chains/quick-task.yaml"}]. `start` would print {"chain_id": "kl-5c4b3a21", "backend": "jsonl"}.
expected_behavior: Starts without invoking kraft-lite:init first and without writing any bindings: a repo with no bindings.yaml runs on the defaults
Runs `start --title "Add CSV export" --chain quick-task --spec docs/specs/csv-export.md` (the chain by its id from `chains --available`), so the spec's gate is skipped
Reports the chain id kl-5c4b3a21 and the jsonl backend, and carries `--chain-id kl-5c4b3a21` onward

query: [user] Kick off a new chain for 'Retry failed imports'.
setup: A Claude Code session at the root of the repo acme/ledger (GitHub, gh installed), `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` set, the kraft-lite skills installed. The repo has `.kraft-lite/registry.yaml` from an older Kraft Lite and no `.kraft-lite/bindings.yaml`. `chains` prints [] (no unfinished chain). Every verb but `chains`, `detect` and `migrate` exits 1 with `kraft-lite: .kraft-lite/registry.yaml is the pre-V1 hook registry. Run: python3 kl.py migrate`. `migrate` would print {"bindings": {"builtins": {"kraft.verify_changed_test_scopes": {"kind": "subprocess", "command": ["just", "test"]}}, "dropped": []}, "chains": []}.
expected_behavior: Runs `migrate` before `start`, as kraft-lite:init's migrate paragraph says (not init's detect-and-write flow, and not deleting the registry)
Tells the user migrate wrote .kraft-lite/bindings.yaml from the registry, to be committed
Then runs `start --title "Retry failed imports"` and invokes kraft-lite:next

query: [user] Start a new Kraft Lite chain for 'Retry failed imports'.
setup: A Claude Code session at the root of the repo acme/ledger, `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` set, the kraft-lite skills installed; `.kraft-lite/bindings.yaml` exists. `chains` prints [{"chain_id": "kl-7f3a91c2", "title": "Ledger export", "status": "open", "node": "verification"}].
expected_behavior: Tells the user the unfinished chain kl-7f3a91c2 'Ledger export' (at verification) exists and asks whether they mean to continue it with kraft-lite:next or start the new one beside it
Runs no `start` until the user answers

query: [user] Kick off a new chain for 'Retry failed imports'.
setup: A Claude Code session at the root of the repo acme/ledger, `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` set, the kraft-lite skills installed. There is no `.kraft-lite/registry.yaml` and no `.kraft-lite/bindings.yaml`. `chains` prints [{"chain_id": "kl-1d2e3f40", "title": "Audit log", "status": "open", "node": "verify"}]. `start` exits 1 with `kraft-lite: chain kl-1d2e3f40 was started on the pre-V1 format. Run: python3 kl.py migrate`. `migrate` would print {"bindings": {}, "chains": [{"from": "kl-1d2e3f40", "to": "kl-9a8b7c6d"}], "note": "Each run now walks Kraft's bundled V1 default chain, not the default of a user or repo library; the legacy run is closed, labelled kraft-migrated-to:<new id>."}.
expected_behavior: Runs `migrate`, as kraft-lite:init's migrate paragraph says, not by deleting or hand-editing state
Reports that no bindings file was written (there was no registry; none is needed) and that 'Audit log' continues as kl-9a8b7c6d; does not say it wrote bindings.yaml
Asks whether to continue Audit log (kl-9a8b7c6d, unfinished) with kraft-lite:next or start 'Retry failed imports' beside it, and starts nothing until the user answers
